title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jayden Reed quiet Sunday
items.desc: Jayden Reed caught 3-of-7 targets for 20 yards in the Packers 39-22 loss against the Vikings.
items.impact: The seven targets were encouraging, but Reed was not anywhere near as productive as Christian Watson and Matthew Golden to open the season. He is a WR4/WR5 heading into Week 2.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Matthew Golden totals 95 yards Sunday
items.desc: Matthew Golden caught 6-of-12 targets for 95 yards in the Packers 39-22 loss against the Vikings.
items.impact: After a lost rookie season, Golden opened this year leading Green Bay receivers in targets on Sunday. He is in the WR3/WR4 mix heading into Week 2 for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Christian Watson scores two touchdowns in big day Sunday
items.desc: Christian Watson caught 6-of-8 targets for 147 yards and two touchdowns in the Packers 39-22 loss against the Vikings on Sunday.
items.impact: Watson exploded for an 81-yard catch and run score early. He was later found in the end zone again by Jordan Love. He will be an upside WR2 next week against the Jets.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chris Brooks sees seven carries Sunday
items.desc: Chris Brooks ran for 29 yards on seven carries in the Packers 39-22 loss against the Vikings on Sunday. He did not catch his lone target.
items.impact: Brooks was the RB2 for Green Bay to open the season behind MarShawn Lloyd. He remains off the fantasy radar for now.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: MarShawn Lloyd sees 13 carries Sunday
items.desc: MarShawn Lloyd ran for 37 yards on 13 carries in the Packers 39-22 loss against the Vikings. He did not catch his lone target.
items.impact: Lloyd was the lead back in the Packers backfield without Josh Jacobs. He was very inefficient as he averaged less than three yards per carry. He'll be a flex play next week against the Jets.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jordan Love throws for 387 yards Sunday
items.desc: Jordan Love completed 21-of-42 passes for 387 yards with two touchdowns and one interception in the Packers 39-22 loss against the Vikings.
items.impact: Love tossed both touchdowns to Christian Watson as those two connected all afternoon. He did lose a fumble as the struggles began in the second half against the Vikings defense. He will face the Jets next week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Bengals D/ST forces four fumbles Sunday
items.desc: The Bengals D/ST allowed 20 points on 282 total yards with four sacks and four fumble recoveries on Sunday against the Buccaneers.
items.impact: The Bengals defense forced three fumbles of Baker Mayfield alone on Sunday and one on Bucky Irving. They will face CJ Stroud and the Texans in Week 2.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Evan McPherson connects on seven kicks Sunday
items.desc: Evan McPherson made 4-of-4 field goal attempts and 3-of-3 extra point attempts on Sunday.
items.impact: McPherson connected on field goals from 20, 55, 58 and 32 yards out. He should remain a fairly reliable weekly play for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Mike Gesicki explodes to open season
items.desc: Mike Gesicki caught 5-of-7 targets for 78 yards with a touchdown in the Bengals 33-27 win over the Buccaneers.
items.impact: While Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins were fairly quiet on Sunday, it was Gesicki who led the team in receiving. Despite his big Week 1 performance, he still isn't a reliable weekly start yet.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Andrei Iosivas catches two passes Sunday
items.desc: Andrei Iosivas caught 2-of-3 targets for 12 yards in the Bengals 33-27 win over the Buccaneers.
items.impact: If you were told before Sunday that Iosivas was going to match Ja'Marr Chase in production, you likely would have expected a lot more. Iosivas remains off the fantasy radar as long as Chase and Tee Higgins are on the field.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tee Higgins totals 59 yards Sunday
items.desc: Tee Higgins caught 3-of-6 targets for 59 yards in the Bengals 33-27 win over the Buccaneers.
items.impact: It could have been worse. You could have Ja'Marr Chase catching two passes for 12 yards. It wasn't the most inspiring start to the season for Higgins, but he still had a couple of big catches. He'll remain an upside WR2 heading into Week 2 against the Texans.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ja'Marr Chase very quiet to open season
items.desc: Ja'Marr Chase caught 2-of-4 targets for 12 yards in the Bengals 33-27 win over the Buccaneers.
items.impact: It was a Week 1 to forget for Chase fantasy managers to say the least. There shouldn't be too much of concern after one week, though he draws an even tougher matchup in Week 2 against the Texans.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Samaje Perine totals eight touches Sunday
items.desc: Samaje Perine ran for 20 yards on five carries in the Bengals 33-27 win over the Buccaneers. He also caught 3-of-3 targets for 30 yards receiving.
items.impact: Perine was out-touched 21-8 by Chase Brown. He remains off the fantasy radar as long as Brown is healthy.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chase Brown finds the end zone Sunday
items.desc: Chase Brown ran for 56 yards and a touchdown on 16 carries in the Bengals 33-27 win over the Buccaneers. He also caught 5-of-6 targets for 22 yards receiving.
items.impact: Brown did not have the most efficient afternoon, but it still got the job done for fantasy managers. He draws a tougher matchup in Week 2 against the Texans.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Joe Burrow not at best Sunday
items.desc: Joe Burrow completed 25-of-35 passes for 254 yards with one touchdown and one interception in the Bengals 33-27 win over the Buccaneers on Sunday.
items.impact: While Cincinnati won the game, Burrow did not have the most inspiring of performances for fantasy managers. That included a pick-six. He will face the Texans defense in Week 2.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Buccaneers D/ST put in tough spot Sunday
items.desc: The Buccaneers D/ST allowed 26 points on 351 total yards with one interception and one sack on Sunday against the Bengals.
items.impact: Cincinnati scored 33 points, but one of them was off a fumble by Baker Mayfield returned for a touchdown. The Bengals also scored 17 other points off Bucs fumbles. The Bucs will be on the streaming radar in Week 2 against the Browns.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chase McLaughlin connects on five kicks Sunday
items.desc: Chase McLaughlin made 2-of-2 field goal attempts and 3-of-3 extra point attempts on Sunday.
items.impact: McLaughlin connected on field goals from 34 and 51 yards out. He should remain a steady option for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cade Otton quiet Sunday
items.desc: Cade Otton caught 3-for-5 targets for 26 yards in the Buccaneers 33-27 loss against the Bengals on Sunday.
items.impact: Otton was third on the team in targets, but he was unable to turn it into much production. He remains a TE2 for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ted Hurst III catches three passes Sunday
items.desc: Ted Hurst III caught 3-of-3 targets for 36 yards in the Buccaneers 33-27 loss on Sunday against the Bengals.
items.impact: Hurst saw more opportunity as the WR3 with Jalen McMillan sidelined and he was able to flash. He'll still remain off the fantasy radar heading into Week 2.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Chris Godwin Jr. hauls in four passes Sunday
items.desc: Chris Godwin Jr. caught 4-of-4 targets for 40 yards in the Buccaneers 33-27 loss against the Bengals on Sunday.
items.impact: Godwin totaled 30 of his 40 yards on one reception. The Bucs offense was unable to get in sync with four lost fumbles. He'll remain a WR3 heading into Week 2 against the Browns.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Emeka Egbuka totals 63 yards Sunday
items.desc: Emeka Egbuka caught 5-of-6 targets for 63 yards in the Buccaneers 33-27 loss against the Bengals on Sunday.
items.impact: Egbuka entered Sunday fully healthy after coming off a toe injury. He got off to a strong start in the first half, but he was not targeted in the second half despite the Bucs trailing. He remains a WR2 heading into Week 2.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kenny Gainwell uninvolved Sunday
items.desc: Kenny Gainwell ran for 15 yards on five carries in the Buccaneers 33-27 loss against the Bengals on Sunday. He also caught his line target for three yards receiving.
items.impact: This felt like the perfect time for Gainwell to make an impact with Tampa Bay falling behind 21-3 early, but it was Bucky Irving in the passing game out of the backfield who caught seven passes. Gainwell is a risky flex play for now in PPR leagues until we see him more involved.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Bucky Irving active in passing game Sunday
items.desc: Bucky Irving ran for 45 yards and a touchdown on eight carries in the Buccaneers 33-27 loss against the Bengals on Sunday. He also caught 7-of-7 targets for 48 yards receiving.
items.impact: Irving took advantage of the gamescript in the passing game with Tampa Bay falling behind 21-3 early. He also lost a fumble, but otherwise performed well. He will be an RB2 play next week against the Browns.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Baker Mayfield loses three fumbles Sunday
items.desc: Baker Mayfield completed 23-of-28 passes for 216 yards in the Buccaneers 33-27 loss against the Bengals on Sunday.
items.impact: Mayfield did not throw a touchdown or interception, but he did lose three fumbles. He was able to run for 30 yards and a touchdown, but struggled through the air and with ball security. He was playing his first game since landing a three-year extension. He'll look to bounce back against the Browns next week.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist) out for several weeks with broken wrist
items.desc: Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist) will miss the next several weeks with a broken wrist he suffered in the Ravens win against the Colts.
items.impact: Lane was seeing some promising usage before exiting with his injury, having a touchdown nullified by holding, another endzone target just out of his reach, and an 11-yard gain on his one reception. The Ravens are now short on receivers unless Zay Flowers, who also exited with an injury, can come back for next week's game. In his absence, expect more work for Rashod Bateman, Chris Moore, and potentially fellow rookie Elijah Sarratt.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Ameer Abdullah racks up 32 yards on the ground in win
items.desc: Ameer Abdullah ran four times for 32 yards and failed to gain a yard on his only catch in the Jaguars' 34-10 win over the Browns.
items.impact: Abdullah was efficient on the ground, having a long of just 12 yards, indicating that when he touched the ball, it was a decent chunk play. It's tough to trust him for fantasy, though, as he doesn't have quite enough involvement to be fantasy-viable.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Josh Cameron snags touchdown in NFL debut
items.desc: Josh Cameron caught both of his targets for 20 yards and a touchdown in the Jaguars' 34-10 win over the Browns on Sunday.
items.impact: The rookie receiver had the wonderful experience of catching a touchdown in his first-ever regular-season game. However, it's hard to take much from it for fantasy, as the Jaguars' passing attack is incredibly spread out and Cameron is buried on the depth chart. His usage might trend up as the season goes along, and he's at least a name to monitor for dynasty formats. But don't expect anything big in the short term.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Travis Hunter quiet in win over Browns
items.desc: Travis Hunter had one catch for eight yards and one carry for three yards in the Jaguars' 34-10 win over the Browns on Sunday. On defense, he had one solo tackle.
items.impact: No matter if you play in offense only or in IDP leagues, Hunter is not a player you're happy with right now. His production and usage isn't that of a first-round NFL pick, especially at second overall. The Jaguars are content to use him as a gadget player, and until that changes, he needs to be off of fantasy radars unless you are in dynasty formats.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Cam Little has nice day against Browns
items.desc: Cam Little made both of his field goal attempts and all four of his PATs in the Jaguars' 34-10 win over the Browns on Sunday.
items.impact: Little should be a nice kicker for those in need of one, or for those who have him, thanks to the firepower the Jags offense possesses. He will look to keep up his success next week against Denver.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Jacksonville Jaguars D/ST shut down hapless Browns
items.desc: The Jacksonville Jaguars D/ST shut down the Browns' offense on Sunday in the team's dominant 34-10 win. They ended the day with five sacks, a pick, and a fumble recovery.
items.impact: It was a great day for the Jags' defense in what was expected to be an easy matchup. They're worth streaming when the matchup is right, but they could be in for tough sledding against Denver next week.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Brenton Strange grabs touchdown in win over Browns
items.desc: Brenton Strange caught two of three targets for 23 yards and a touchdown in the Jaguars' 34-10 win over the Browns on Sunday.
items.impact: Strange was among ten other targeted receivers who were trying to feast off of an extremely small pie of 21 total targets. And he was one of the lucky ones with a touchdown. He should continue to see work as the top tight end for the offense, but things are so spread out that it might be hard to rely on him on a weekly basis.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Jakobi Meyers snags touchdown in win
items.desc: Jakobi Meyers caught both of his targets for 40 yards and a touchdown in the Jaguars' 34-10 win over the Browns. He also ran once for two yards.
items.impact: Meyers didn't see a lot of targets, just two to be exact, but he made them count. Trevor Lawrence only threw the ball 21 times today, not counting throwaways, and ten different players received a target, so there wasn't much to go around. Hopefully Meyers will see more targets next week against Denver in what should be a more competitive game script.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Chris Rodriguez Jr. quiet in win over Browns
items.desc: Chris Rodriguez Jr. ran six times for 23 yards in the Jaguars' 34-10 Week 1 win over the Browns.
items.impact: Rodriguez wasn't involved much in the blowout win, carrying the ball only six times. It's possible the team wanted to see more of Tuten today than CRod, but that's purely speculation. As for now, it's hard to start Rodriguez until we know more about what his workload could look like on a weekly basis.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Trevor Lawrence flawless in big win over Browns
items.desc: Trevor Lawrence completed 18-of-23 passes for 245 yards and four touchdowns in the Jaguars' 34-10 win over the Browns. He also ran twice for three yards.
items.impact: Lawrence played on easy mode against a Browns defense that just couldn't create stops. He had only five incompletions to four touchdowns on the day, a great ratio to have. With their win over the Browns, the Jags are the only AFC South team to clinch a win on Sunday. He faces a much tougher test against the Broncos next week.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Parker Washington snags touchdown in win
items.desc: Parker Washington caught five of six targets for 83 yards and a touchdown in the Jaguars' 34-10 win over the Browns.
items.impact: Washington answered the call of all the offseason hype with flying colors. He scored on a 30-yard bomb from Trevor Lawrence early on in the game and kept showing up to make plays afterwards. Expect Washington to continue to be a focal point in the offense, especially if Brian Thomas Jr. were to miss any time.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Bhayshul Tuten racks up 66 yards on the ground in win
items.desc: Bhayshul Tuten ran 15 times for 66 yards in the Jaguars' 34-10 win over the Browns on Sunday. He also caught his only target for 22 yards.
items.impact: Tuten led the Jags in rushing attempts in the win, but didn't have much to show in terms of fantasy scoring in half- or full-PPR formats. But to be fair, he was efficient in his touches, and it's likely that better days are ahead for the apparent Jags RB1.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Cleveland Browns D/ST outmatched in loss to Jaguars
items.desc: The Cleveland Browns D/ST was outmatched in the team's 34-10 loss to the Jaguars, achieving just one sack in the blowout loss.
items.impact: It was a rough showing for the Browns, who were hoping that their defense would at least have some semblance of its form from last year. At least in Week 1, that was not the case in the slightest. They're firmly out of streaming consideration unless it's the best of matchups.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Andre Szmyt manages four kicking points in loss
items.desc: Andre Szmyt made his only PAT and field goal attempts in the Browns' 34-10 blowout loss to the Jaguars.
items.impact: Szmyt is going to have a low floor and low ceiling in Cleveland this year, in what is a rebuilding season for the team. Don't expect much this season.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Deshaun Watson struggles in season opener
items.desc: Deshaun Watson completed 16-of-22 passes for 205 yards, a touchdown, and an interception in the Browns' 34-10 loss to the Jaguars on Sunday. He also ran six times for 38 yards.
items.impact: Watson struggled mightily all day, throwing an interception on the first drive and nearly losing a fumble later on. He took five sacks and plenty of hits, and 62 of his 205 yards came in the Browns' final drive in garbage time. It was a rough day at the office, and the drumbeat to replace him with Shedeur Sanders will only grow after this performance.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Jerry Jeudy catches two passes in loss
items.desc: Jerry Jeudy caught two of four targets for 26 yards in the Browns' 34-10 loss to the Jaguars on Sunday.
items.impact: Jeudy's four targets tied him with Denzel Boston for second on the team behind KC Concepcion, but he didn't have much to show for it. Cleveland struggled to move the ball all day, leading to many short drives and little opportunity for the offensive players to get any momentum. Hopefully, things will turn more in a positive direction next week against the Bucs.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Denzel Boston snags bomb touchdown in loss
items.desc: Denzel Boston caught two of four targets for 59 yards and a touchdown in the Browns' 34-10 loss to the Jaguars on Sunday.
items.impact: Boston had the Browns' only touchdown, though sadly it was in garbage time. His four targets tied with Jerry Jeudy for second on the team, an encouraging sign for his future usage as he gets further acclimated to the NFL game.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: KC Concepcion snags four passes in loss to Jags
items.desc: KC Concepcion caught four of five targets for 43 yards in the Browns' 34-10 loss to the Jaguars. He also ran the ball three times for 15 yards.
items.impact: While it wasn't a massive day, it was encouraging that Concepcion got touches as both a receiver and out of the backfield, showing the team wanted to get the ball in his hands. A loss is a loss, but brighter days should be ahead for Concepcion.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Harold Fannin Jr. held in check on Sunday
items.desc: Harold Fannin Jr. caught two of three targets for 21 yards in the Browns' 34-10 loss to the Jaguars on Sunday.
items.impact: Fannin was held in check on Sunday, along with the rest of the Browns' offense. He will hope for better days next week against the Buccaneers.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Quinshon Judkins quiet in blowout loss to Jaguars
items.desc: Quinshon Judkins ran 12 times for 33 yards in the Browns' 34-10 loss to the Jaguars on Sunday. He also caught both of his targets for 17 yards.
items.impact: Judkins was held back by the Browns inept offensive showing, as everyone except Deshaun Watson and Denzel Boston was held under 10 PPR points, and those two got over that because of a bomb touchdown in garbage time. Judkins is the lead back, but his fantasy value is highly questionable unless something changes.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Caleb Williams posts four touchdowns in Week 1 win over Panthers
items.desc: Caleb Williams completed 21-of-29 pass attempts for 269 yards and two touchdowns while also rushing 10 times for 65 yards and two touchdowns in a 59-37 Week 1 win over the Carolina Panthers.
items.impact: Williams was electric behind center to begin the season for head coach Ben Johnson, recording multiple touchdowns through the air and on the ground in the win. The dual-threat quarterback will look to offer fantasy manager a dynamic option in a favorable Week 2 contest against the Minnesota Vikings.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Kyle Monangai reaches 100 yards in Week 1 win
items.desc: Kyle Monangai rushed 10 times for 100 yards and one touchdown while also catching both of his targets for 24 yards in a 59-37 win over the Carolina Panthers in Week 1.
items.impact: Monangai made the most of limited touches highlighted by a 61-yard rushing touchdown in the win. The second-year running back will look to take advantage of a risky Minnesota Vikings defense in Week 2 for fantasy managers.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: D'Andre Swift rushes for three touchdowns in Week 1 win over Panthers
items.desc: D'Andre Swift carried the ball 18 times for 124 rushing yards and three touchdowns while also catching his lone target for 10 yards in the Bears' 59-37 Week 1 win over the Carolina Panthers.
items.impact: Swift led an impactful Chicago backfield attack in the season opener for head coach Ben Johnson, averaging 6.9 yards per carry in the win. The veteran running back will look to take advantage of another favorable matchup against the Minnesota Vikings in Week 2 for fantasy managers.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Tyler Warren finds end zone in Week 1 loss
items.desc: Tyler Warren hauled in three of his five targets for 13 yards and one touchdown in a 41-23 Week 1 loss to the Baltimore Ravens.
items.impact: Warren was mostly bottled up by a stiff Baltimore defense, averaging 4.3 yards per reception in the Week 1 loss. The tight end remains a primary pass-catching offense for head coach Shane Steichen ahead of a Week 2 contest against the Kansas City Chiefs.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Jonathan Taylor rushes for two touchdowns in Week 1 loss
items.desc: Jonathan Taylor carried the ball 19 times for 98 yards and two touchdowns while also catching three of his four targets for 23 yards in the Colts' 41-23 loss to the Baltimore Ravens in Week 1.
items.impact: Taylor was the lone bright spot in an underwhelming Colts offense to begin the season, averaging 5.2 yards per carry in the loss. The superstar running back will look to remain an impactful backfield option in Week 2 against the Kansas City Chiefs.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Malik Nabers (knee) active for Week 1
items.desc: Malik Nabers (knee) is officially active for Week 1 for the New York Giants against the Dallas Cowboys according to Mike Garafolo.
